_note: REAL MONEY, backtest sizing at tiny scale: x_reentry:ALL only, as the real-money test ran it (one bet per market): the only real-money golden strategy (Nov 5; profitable in every out-of-sample period at these limits with real fills: final exam +$19.98, Nov 1-4 +$10.09, Jul-Aug archive +$29.01; 1,653 filled bets, t 3.18), the backtest's Kelly sizing on a $0.50 base (up to 5x = $2.50 on the strongest gaps), at most 10 contracts; when a signal is worth less than one contract, exactly 1 contract is bought if it costs at most $1 (the backtest takes those trades at fractional size).
